title: AIDecision
description: Structured message classification returned by AI. The app decides which actions to issue.

messageId.description: Exact id of the ExternalMessage being classified.

decision.description: urgent: recommend immediate attention; allow: eligible for normal delivery; hold: recommend deferred delivery.

relevance.description: Relevance to the current task, from 0 (none) to 1 (highest).

requiresReply.description: Whether the incoming message requires a reply from the user.

replyDraft.description: Generated reply content when a reply is required and automationMode is on or suggestion. Null when no reply should be generated.

reason.description: Short human-readable explanation, never a command to execute.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.
